UPDATE users SET roles = (
            SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT r ORDER BY r), ARRAY[]::TEXT[])
            FROM (
                SELECT UNNEST($2::TEXT[]) AS r
                UNION
                SELECT role FROM user_manual_roles WHERE user_id = $1
            ) all_roles
        )
        WHERE id = $1
        RETURNING roles AS "roles!"
